name: com.eliranshaya.devkit
description: Zero-setup, runtime-generated developer and cheat panel for Unity. Drop one empty GameObject into a scene, press F1, and a full debug panel builds itself at runtime - no prefabs, no sprites, no scene wiring. Stripped entirely from release builds through the DEVKIT_ENABLED define symbol.

samples.description: A wallet, a level manager and an IDevKitGameAdapter wired to the built-in modules.
